lens: Simulated Austin Wintory lens: musical arc, personal theme, and ending integration. Source-based critical exercise; not Austin Wintory's opinions.

strengths.finding: The Journey ending has a composed arc: recalled chapter phrases accumulate supporting layers, yield to a restrained theme, fade, and leave two seconds before credits. The visual clock follows audible audio time.

The eleven-place finale connects earned instrumentation with saved personal phrases and reserves the cello theme until after a whole-mix pause. The gate controls effects returns as well as dry voices, with explicit pause/headroom regression criteria.

issues.finding: The Journey arrangement can erase distinctions in a player's melody: every recalled pitch is forced onto one of three current chord tones. A small pure-function probe maps input MIDI 61, 62, and 63 to the same output 61 at the same first-chapter onset. This proves a loss of pitch identity; its perceptual importance remains unlistened.
issues.remedy: Retain scale-compatible melodic passing tones or preserve the player's interval contour while using accompaniment/register choices to manage clashes. Compare original and arranged phrases by listening.

issues.finding: The eleven-place ending pads its duration by continuing the layers after the theme, including the Faros melody; at the final transport boundary it stops adding events without an authored gain taper. Existing notes can decay, so this is an ending-shape limitation rather than a verified click.
issues.remedy: Shape the final bars with selective layer withdrawals or a scheduled stage-gain release, and listen through the handoff back to the World.

evidence.executed: One lightweight Node pure-function probe of finaleArrangement; MIDI inputs 60,61,62,63,64 yielded first phrase pitches 57,61,61,61,64.
testScope: tests/song_stage_mix.py:16 uses a continuous triangle-oscillator stand-in for World music; lines 28–30 verify headroom and increasing level, not perceived arrangement clarity.
tests/victory_mix.py:28 checks headroom, lines 29–31 check bounded addition and unchanged filter/output.

limits: All numerical scores are technical/provisional assessments of implementation, not listening scores.
No actual listening, browser viewing, player observation, heavy render, or full suite. Visual and sensation scores are null because those experiences were unobserved.
